Vision, Mission & Purpose - Lala Rural College
🎯 Vision & Mission
Our Vision
is to transform the institute into a learning and application hub with employability in mind and to create knowledge-based human resources equipped with a scientific temper and team spirit—making them competent and ethically strong citizens who can successfully face challenges in life and effectively contribute to society.
Our Mission
is to emancipate the uninitiated mind into developing self-confidence; becoming independent and original in thought. To make our taught appreciate education as a valued tool and above all, to make them the true citizens of our nation.
🌟 Our Purpose
Our purpose is to illuminate the very essence of our institution, showcasing its values, achievements, and commitment to academic excellence. Established with a vision to empower the rural community through education,
Lala Rural College
stands as a beacon of knowledge and progress in our region.
At the heart of our mission is a dedication to nurturing young minds, fostering innovation, and promoting holistic development. Through rigorous academic programs, state-of-the-art facilities, and a passionate faculty, we create an environment where students are encouraged to explore, learn, and grow.
Our commitment to quality education is reflected not only in the academic accomplishments of our students but also in the positive impact they make in their communities. As you delve into the depths of our institution, I am confident that you will discover the unwavering spirit and dedication that defines
Lala Rural College
.
Principal's Message - Lala Rural College
📋 Message from the Principal, Lala Rural College
Dr. HIMABRATA CHAKRAVARTY
Principal
Lala Rural College, Lala
M.Sc., M.A., Ph.D., B.Ed., PGDHE, PGDMM, PGDCA, NET, SLET
Greetings & welcome to Lala Rural College, Lala. Established in 1964 with the philosophy
‘विद्याऽमृतमश्नुते’
; this institute of Higher Education has come a long way from its fledgling start. Treasuring the efforts and vision of its founders and the selfless support of the commune of Lala, today Lala Rural College has established itself as an HEI of repute in the field of Arts & Commerce for Higher Secondary and Under Graduate courses.
Affiliated to Assam University, Silchar, the Institute is constantly striving to keep pace with the changing dynamics and demands of Higher Education.
A short walk alone is difficult, but the long journey for the Institute feels like a few steps; given the support, dedication, toil and care from all its staff – past & present! Equally important is the extended family of Guardians and well wishers who have ever been by the institute – through thick & thin.
Lala Rural College, Lala has its own story to tell. It is poised for scripting a bright future for itself and for the students who call it their alma mater.
Our Vision
is to transform the Institute into a Learning and Application Hub, with employability in mind.
Our Mission
is to emancipate the Uninitiated Mind into developing Self Confidence; becoming Independent & Original in Thought. To make our taught appreciate Education as a Value Tool & above all, to make them the True citizens of our Great Nation. Come; let us make the journey Together!
Jai Hind.
